name: EPIC 248171802

text.card: A red giant 3,519 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.37 solar masses and 13.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,660 K at its surface.
